issues.description: Hit formula description in combat-mechanics.md and combat-algorithm.md have slight structural differences. combat-mechanics.md describes range penalties as 'added to Defense' while combat-algorithm.md Section 9-10 implements them as separate subtractive modifiers.
issues.suggestion: Harmonize the formula descriptions so both documents use identical terminology for range penalty application.

issues.description: Cross-reference from combat-mechanics.md to force-fields.md was noted as added in gaps-resolved.md, but the actual reference is a brief 'See force-fields.md' line. The shield absorption values table could be duplicated or more prominently linked.
issues.suggestion: Add explicit shield absorption values inline or add a more prominent cross-reference with specific section pointer.

issues.description: The Chameleon spy bonus documented as 'intentional balance decision at 60%' in gaps-resolved.md is reasonable, but race-stats-complete.md doesn't have an explicit 'moo1_note' field for this deviation like it does for Ferrets and Mice.
issues.suggestion: Add 'moo1_note' field to Chameleons master_spies ability documenting the intentional deviation from Darlok's +80%.

summary: The gap resolution work for task fix-001 is complete and well-documented. All 18 identified gaps have been addressed. Key verifications: (1) combat-algorithm.md now includes Section 25 with comprehensive Auto-Combat AI Targeting Priorities; (2) combat-mechanics.md has the MOO1-faithful differential hit formula and detailed missile base mechanics; (3) research-formulas.md correctly caps miniaturization at 50% matching MOO1; (4) race-stats-complete.md has been updated with Budgies +3 Initiative, Mice +2 starting Robotic Controls, and Ferrets +4 Attack Level. The gaps-resolved.md document provides excellent traceability from original gaps to resolutions. Three minor consistency issues noted but none are blocking. Work is ready for implementation.
